run_time_func_benchmark: run time_func to benchmark a callable function over 100 iterations and print average ms
test_time_func_warmup: test time_func warmup runs 5 iterations before measuring performance of the target function
create_benchmark_with_time_func: create a benchmark using time_func with a custom number of iterations and name
review_time_func_timing: review time_func which uses perf_counter to measure and report average execution time in ms
summarize_time_func: summarize time_func a utility that benchmarks callables with warmup and reports milliseconds per call
